mapper.select: SELECT id, flow_id AS flowId, io_type AS ioType, field_id AS fieldId, field_type AS fieldType, longname, ref, required, multi, array_flag AS arrayFlag, source_info AS sourceInfo, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM flow_field_detail WHERE flow_id = #{flowId} AND io_type = #{ioType} ORDER BY id ASC
